baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active participle at word 1 is paired with giving at word 3, lordly nurture at word 4, and prior ihsan at word 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Giving does not end when the object is offered: taking completes a reciprocal circuit. The Lord's gradual nurture forms both the gift and people able to receive it, while their prior ihsan makes reception continuous with their own beneficence.

activation_trace.role: Taking and enclosing supply the recipient's active completion of the transfer.
Giving supplies the transfer whose endpoint is active reception.
Gradual repair and nurture make the giver's role formative rather than merely possessive.
Excellent action and beneficence make prior giving the human-side counterpart of present reception.

changed_reading.before: They passively enjoy a reward bestowed by their Lord.
changed_reading.after: They actively complete a nurtured giver-recipient circuit, receiving in a mode continuous with their earlier beneficence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction at words 6-9 places being muhsinin before the deictic event.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal precedence separates character from payoff: ihsan was already an inhabited condition before the present taking. The gift discloses and answers that prior disposition rather than producing it.

activation_trace.role: Being present through a time supplies the durative state behind the predicate.
Temporal advance places the ethical condition prior to the received outcome.
Practiced excellence supplies the antecedent disposition rather than a reaction to reward.

changed_reading.before: They had performed unspecified good deeds at some earlier point.
changed_reading.after: The scene reveals a sustained ethical disposition that preceded and remains causally distinct from its outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 1, 3, 4, and 9 can describe acquisition, accessibility, formation, and strenuous excellence as one fit.
baseline_models.mechanism: The provision is made accessible while the recipient is gradually cultivated into readiness. Taking is therefore neither seizure nor automatic delivery but a fit between an arriving good and a prepared capacity.

activation_trace.role: An affair approached through its proper access and made ready supplies the gift's availability.
Acquiring something for oneself supplies appropriation rather than mere proximity.
Stagewise cultivation supplies the formation of receptive capacity.
Exertion to one's limit supplies the costly preparation behind that capacity.

changed_reading.before: A finished reward is simply handed to its beneficiaries.
changed_reading.after: Reception occurs as a prepared fit: provision becomes accessible to recipients cultivated through prior strenuous excellence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence can be read as a logistics chain: dispersal, loaded carriage, compliant flow, and allocation of an affair. The focus then supplies the missing terminal operation, recipients taking what has been routed to them.

activation_trace.role: Wind-driven winnowing supplies the chain's initial dispersal operation.
Lifting an exposed payload supplies carriage after dispersal.
A heavy load specifies that the carriage moves substantive freight.
Uninterrupted flowing supplies transit through the delivery chain.
Light compliant motion makes the transit unobstructed.
Separating apportioned shares supplies destination-specific distribution.
The affair or state supplies what the distributing operation administers.
A directed watercourse supplies the focus's image of routed arrival.
Taking hold supplies the terminal uptake that completes distribution.

structural_cues: 51:1-4 is a fa-linked series of active participles, and 51:16 reopens with another active participle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered operations and branch images of dispersal, carriage, flow, and division; I supply the causal arrow that treats them as one delivery chain ending in reception. They may instead remain oath-images without a direct logistical relation to 51:16.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts an isolated reward scene.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the receiving station of a previously staged distribution system: apportioned provision becomes complete only when taken.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promise is first asserted as truthful, then joined to reckoning that will fall and become fixed; after the focus, provision and promise are colocated and sworn to be real. Taking marks the threshold where promissory speech becomes an apportioned possession.

activation_trace.role: A verbal promise opening expectation supplies the initially nonpossessed object.
Fulfillment of promise in action supplies the movement from assertion to performance.
Accounting and recompense supply the settlement framework for the transfer.
Falling and becoming fixed supply realization as an event.
An apportioned grant identifies the realized object as a distributed share.
The promise's recurrence beside provision closes the pre-focus expectation loop.
Fixed correspondence to reality supplies ontological confirmation.
Self-evidencing speech supplies the comparison by which reality is certified.
Giving supplies the promise's conversion into a transferred object.
Taking hold supplies the point at which fulfillment becomes possession.

structural_cues: Promise language brackets the focus at 51:5 and 51:22, while 51:23 closes the unit with an oath and a speech analogy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promise, enacted truth, fixed occurrence, apportioned provision, and taking; I infer a speech-to-event-to-possession sequence. The promise may denote judgment as a whole rather than the gifts taken in 51:16 alone.

changed_reading.before: They receive goods after an independently guaranteed promise.
changed_reading.after: Their taking is itself the performative completion of the promise, where spoken expectation becomes fixed and possessable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The condemned are made to taste the trial they rushed, while the protected enter covered gardens and springs and take a gift. Tasting and taking become opposed modes of embodied consequence, and prior ihsan reads as the disposition disclosed by an assay.

activation_trace.role: Testing metal or a person supplies an assay that discloses prior quality.
Experiential tasting supplies the condemned group's bodily reception of consequence.
Premature hastening supplies their disordered relation to the awaited event.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the contrasting recipient disposition.
A tree-covered garden supplies the protected setting of positive reception.
A flowing spring supplies the positive consequence's immediately experienceable medium.
Taking supplies the righteous group's contrasting mode of embodied reception.
Prior excellent conduct supplies the quality that the opposed outcomes disclose.

structural_cues: The imperative to taste in 51:14 and the active participle taking in 51:16 frame a subject-group reversal across 51:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trial, tasting, hastening, protection, gardens, springs, and taking; I infer a deliberate symmetry of embodied consequences and treat ihsan as assay-disclosed quality. The two scenes may instead be simple contrast without a shared reception mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus only depicts bliss after punishment has been described.
changed_reading.after: It completes a paired consequence scene: one group tastes what exposed its disorder, while the other takes what answers a previously proven disposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus practices unpack ihsan as disciplined asymmetry: they reduce their own repose, seek covering rather than presume sufficiency, and recognize an enforceable share for both requester and deprived. Those who released what they held now take what their Lord gives, reversing their social role without erasing dependence.

activation_trace.role: Smallness supplies deliberate restriction of self-directed nighttime consumption.
Night and its darkness locate the hidden temporal discipline.
Seeking the covering of fault supplies continued dependence despite excellence.
Accumulated property supplies the held resource from which they release a share.
A binding entitlement makes distribution fulfillment of a claim, not optional largesse.
Request and seeking supply one visible recipient channel.
Deprivation and missed access supply the recipient whose claim is not voiced.
Beneficence and excellence bind restraint, penitence, and distribution into the prior disposition.
Giving reverses the direction of transfer when the former givers become recipients.
Taking marks the ethical givers' new role as receivers.

structural_cues: The repeated كانوا links 51:16 to the habitual clauses in 51:17-18, and 51:19 continues the behavioral exposition.
The branchless sleep verb in 51:17 is used only as a structural description of reduced repose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated past-habit construction and the sequence of little sleep, seeking forgiveness, and a fixed share in wealth; I infer that these clauses unpack muhsinin and create a giver-to-receiver reversal. They may be representative practices rather than an exhaustive definition of ihsan.

changed_reading.before: Muhsinin is a broad merit label explaining why they receive reward.
changed_reading.after: Muhsinin names people who restrained themselves, remained dependent, and honored others' claims; their present taking reverses their former role as distributors.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth-self-sky sweep places signs and provision throughout the perceiver's environment. Taking what the Lord gives can therefore include cognitive uptake: seeing an available mark until it becomes settled knowledge, alongside receiving material provision.

activation_trace.role: The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the first external field of disclosure.
A manifest mark supplies content that can be perceptually received.
Settled knowledge after doubt supplies the completed cognitive uptake.
The thing's own self supplies the inward field of disclosure.
Insight of the heart supplies assimilation rather than optical registration alone.
The over-arching sky supplies the final external field and source-location.
Apportioned provision joins material reception to the preceding reception of signs.
Taking hold supplies appropriation of what is available across those fields.
Lord-related knowledge supplies an epistemic dimension to the gift.

structural_cues: The locative sequence moves from earth to selves to sky, while the focus's unrestricted ما does not specify a single kind of gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies signs, certainty, selves, insight, sky, provision, and an unrestricted focus object; I infer that reception can be epistemic as well as material. The signs may instead function only as proofs external to what is given in 51:16.

changed_reading.before: What they take consists only of garden goods.
changed_reading.after: Taking also names perceptual appropriation: disclosed marks become insight and certainty, while provision remains a coexisting material gift.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material water branches beneath ordinary transfer verbs. It remains anchored in the focus through the water-holding branch of taking, the channel branch of coming, and abundant water under lordship, then gains local support from flow, springs, and rain-provision. Downstream prose should present it only as a hydraulic analogy for receptive capacity, not as a lexical replacement for the syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 1, 3, and 4 can form a catchment-channel-abundance image within the focus.

activation_trace.role: A basin that holds water supplies the recipient as a capacity that retains influx.
A channel that directs water supplies the giver-to-recipient route.
Abundant gathered water supplies the source's plenitude.
Flowing supplies movement between source and catchment.
A running spring supplies the immediately adjacent water source.
Rain descending as provision closes the ecological supply cycle.

changed_reading.before: The beneficiaries are passive containers for discrete rewards.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, prior ihsan has formed them as maintained catchments able to receive, retain, and participate in a continuing flow of provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the form-taking branch of أخذ beside the woven paths of the sky. It remains anchored in the focus's taking, formative lordship, and ihsan, while nearby divergent speech and turning-away provide a negative contrast. Downstream prose should qualify it as a conduct-pattern activation rather than claim that the direct object literally means a code or woven form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Taking at word 1 can activate adopting a way or form, with lordly cultivation and ihsan specifying its ethical shape.

activation_trace.role: Taking on a people's gait or form supplies reception as patterned conduct.
Gradual cultivation supplies the formation of that conduct.
Excellent action supplies the visible ethical quality of the adopted pattern.
Interwoven ordered paths supply the positive image of coherent pattern.
Each taking a path unlike the other's supplies the contrasting fragmentation.
Being turned from a proper direction supplies the failure to inhabit the coherent pattern.

changed_reading.before: They take external objects while their earlier conduct is a separate qualification.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, what is received also takes form in them: cultivated conduct embodies an ordered pattern opposed to divergent, redirected paths.

strongest_changes: The opening participial sequence makes 51:16 the uptake point of an apportioned delivery chain.
Promise, truth, occurrence, provision, and taking form a speech-to-event-to-possession sequence.
51:17-19 turns generic ihsan into disciplined restraint, dependence, and honoring others' claims, reversing former givers into present receivers.
Tasting trial and taking gift can coexist as opposed modes of embodied consequence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is unusually productive as a transfer hinge: it preserves reward, ethical reciprocity, realized promise, perceptual uptake, and material-flow readings without forcing them into one referent.
remaining_uncertainties: The operations in 51:1-4 may function only as oath-images rather than a literal delivery chain.
The exact reach of ذلك remains open: it can point broadly to the present condition or contrast it with prior worldly conduct.
The hydraulic and patterned-conduct readings are deliberately retained as branch-distant analogies, not direct lexical substitutions.
